scripts.audit: pnpm -w run audit:deps && pnpm -w run audit:rust
scripts.check: pnpm -w run check:rust && pnpm -w run check:frontend
scripts.test: pnpm -w run test:rust && pnpm -w run test:frontend
scripts.test:benchmark-contracts:frontend: pnpm --dir apps/client exec vitest run src/lib/benchmark --maxWorkers=1
scripts.test:benchmark-contracts: pnpm -w run test:benchmark-contracts:rust && pnpm -w run test:benchmark-contracts:frontend
scripts.validate:rust: pnpm -w run check:rust && pnpm -w run test:rust
scripts.validate:frontend: pnpm -w run check:frontend && pnpm -w run test:frontend && pnpm -w run editor-check && pnpm -w run bundle-contracts
scripts.validate: pnpm -w run validate:rust && pnpm -w run validate:frontend
scripts.validate:full: pnpm -w run audit && pnpm -w run validate
